not_affected.adv3_c491e0c96e47acd4: The Brotli certificate-decompression path does not exist at v/0.23.4. RUSTSEC-2026-0348 (the same advisory as GHSA-h2v8-394m-p7vv) records introduced 0.23.9, fixed 0.23.46, so the frozen tag predates the feature; the GHSA record's coarse "introduced 0" interval is contradicted by the RUSTSEC range. Static check at 1dee8b13134d877ade94dda7b68c7bf072e18d62: rustls/src/compress.rs does not exist, no brotli dependency appears in Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, and there is no CompressedCertificate message handling (the only "compression" in the client is the TLS record Compression::Null at client/hs.rs:329 and :572). Both fix commits (1aa987af, 402b7b78) modify only rustls/src/compress.rs.

notes: Both promoted advisories cover v/0.23.4 by their published ranges: RUSTSEC-2026-0346 (introduced 0.21.0, fixed 0.23.46) and RUSTSEC-2026-0349 (introduced 0.0.0-0, fixed 0.23.46).

GHSA-c8m5 is located at the #[derive(Debug)] on Tls13ClientSessionValue (persist.rs:71-72) as the public leak path; the secret itself lives in ClientSessionCommon (:204-210, secret at :207) and PayloadU8/Zeroizing Debug render it as hex.

GHSA-w44r is located at the early set_kx_hint in handle_server_hello (tls13.rs:150-154); the hint is consumed by initial_key_share at :207. At 0.23.4 there is no hybrid/PQ group, so only the pre-authentication poisoning primitive is present.
GHSA-h2v8 is confirmed_not_affected: rustls/src/compress.rs and every brotli reference are absent at the SHA, and RUSTSEC-2026-0348 puts the introduction at 0.23.9.

The two RUSTSEC records (disc2 candidates) are closed as duplicates of the promoted GHSA candidates; the two other snapshot candidates (CVE-2024-11738 and GHSA-vp88) were already confirmed_not_affected by the range pass.
OSV GIT fixed events point at the 0.24-dev commits (f5f7bf50, 8fa0dc5d); the 0.23-branch fixes used here are dcdb9464 and f04804fa, both contained in the v/0.23.46 tag.
